human_review_checklist.item: No section headings in cover letter
human_review_checklist.note: Cover letter is flowing prose with no ## headers

human_review_checklist.item: Cover letter has authentic opening hook
human_review_checklist.note: Opens with a project story which is good, but 'What draws me to the AI Engineer, Gen AI/SWE role' is somewhat formulaic

human_review_checklist.item: Company name and role appear naturally
human_review_checklist.note: CoreWeave and role mentioned naturally in body
TypeScript mentioned in skills but barely in cover letter; CI/CD mentioned only as 'preference' - gaps not acknowledged
Phrases like 'production systems', 'enterprise', 'measurable user outcomes' appear generic
Email and phone clearly visible in both documents
Uses numbers: 100 users, 300+, tens of thousands of documents, 3 junior engineers

revision_suggestions: Add more specific metrics to cover letter (e.g., 'improved precision by X%', 'reduced latency by Yms')
Acknowledge TypeScript and CI/CD gaps explicitly - mention willingness to grow in these areas
Remove template-sounding phrases like 'What draws me to' - try 'I'm excited about' or lead with impact
Add more CoreWeave-specific reasoning - why THIS company vs other AI infra providers
Weave in TypeScript experience more naturally into cover letter narrative
Specify CI/CD experience with actual tools (GitHub Actions, etc.) if applicable
strengths: Strong technical foundation clearly documented - Python, LLMs, RAG, vector DBs all covered
Quantifiable achievements in resume: 100 users piloted, 300+ onboarding, tens of thousands of documents
Project story opening in cover letter is engaging and shows real work
Mentions specific tech stack: FastAPI, Pydantic, LangChain, Agents SDK, MCP, pgvector, Chroma
Good balance of technical depth and business impact in resume bullets
Education background shows continuous learning (Turing School after Economics degree)
No section headings or broken formatting in cover letter
weaknesses: Gap handling FAIL: TypeScript and CI/CD skills not addressed despite being in job requirements
Narrative voice partially AI-sounding: phrases like 'measurable user outcomes' feel generic
Company specificity weak: CoreWeave connection to W&B mentioned but not deeply explored
ATS coverage incomplete: CI/CD only mentioned once vaguely, TypeScript barely in cover letter
Some resume bullets lack specificity (e.g., 'high accuracy' instead of actual %)
Some cover letter sentences overly long and convoluted
